title: Vergil Lawn Chair - Devil May Cry
description: Adds a decorative lawn chair inspired by Vergil from Devil May Cry.
body:
# Vergil Lawn Chair - Devil Mine Craft(DMC)

Adds a decorative lawn chair inspired by Vergil from Devil May Cry.
Purely cosmetic and made for fun builds and memes.


<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/k4GRgGdbDyE" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>






### 🧭 Finding the Structure
You can locate the structures in the Stony peaks and Snowy Slopes biome or you can locate the structure using this command

```
/locate structure vergilchair:vergil_chair
```



### 🗿 Features
- Decorative lawn chair block
- Lightweight and vanilla-friendly


### 🔗 Compatibility
- Works with any world generation mods/datapacks
